shortDescription: South Africa's manufacturing output rose 1.1% year-on-year in July, after falling by revised 1.8% year-on-year in June, statistics agency data showed on Thursday.Factory production increased 2.2% month-on-month in July, after increasing by a revised 0.8% month-on-month in June.

children: South Africa's manufacturing output rose 1.1% year-on-year in July, after falling by revised 1.8% year-on-year in June, statistics agency data showed on Thursday.
Factory production increased 2.2% month-on-month in July, after increasing by a revised 0.8% month-on-month in June.
